artifact_identity.published_or_effective_version: These rules are effective as of August 7, 2026.

citations.why_required: Object/copy semantics underlie copiable-value and copy handling.
Permanent persistence underlies artifact permanence and type-change families.
Token creation is a top requirement-family concept across the six locked decks.
Target selection underlies targeting requirement families.
Timing windows gate flash and chapter timing families.
Counter placement incl. loyalty counters is an explicit requirement family.
Artifact rules underlie the largest artifact-family cluster (equipment/vehicles below).
Stack resolution underlies counter/setup and activated-ability cost families.
Combat damage triggers are explicit requirement families.
Layer interaction underlies continuous-effect and type-layer families.
Mill keyword action family.
Scry keyword action family.
Populate creates tokens; supports token_creation family.
Amass creates/grows Army tokens; supports token families.
Equip underlies equipment clusters incl. commander-dependent equip costs.
Convoke cost-reduction family.
Living Weapon equipment enters with a Germ token.
Vehicles/crew are core to the Buckle Up deck cluster.
Partner modifies commander designation; present in pinned oracle texts.
Foretell underlies the Phantom Premonition cluster and face-down exile handling.
Reconfigure bridges equipment and creature rules (Chishiro cluster).
SBAs are an explicit family and background termination rules.
Saga chapter timing family.
